test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution states about the establishment of Election Commission in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Article 324**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 324** of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of the **Election Commission of India (ECI)**.
 
• The Election Commission is responsible for the **superintendence, direction, and control** of elections to the Parliament, State Legislatures, and offices of the President and Vice-President of India.
 
• This article vests the power of conducting free and fair elections in an **independent constitutional body**, ensuring the democratic framework of the country.
 
• The Election Commission is a **permanent and independent body** to ensure that elections are conducted in a fair and unbiased manner.
 
• The Commission consists of the **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)** and other Election Commissioners as the President may appoint.
 
• The powers and functions under Article 324 ensure **autonomy and authority** to the Election Commission to maintain the integrity of the electoral process in India.
 
• It is a vital provision to safeguard the principle of **free and fair elections**, which is the cornerstone of a democratic system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 326**__

 __
 
• **Article 326** deals with the **elections to the House of the People** and to the Legislative Assemblies of States based on **adult suffrage**.
 
• It provides that every citizen who is not less than **18 years** of age and is not otherwise disqualified under the Constitution or law is entitled to vote.
 
 
 
• **Article 325**__
 __
 
• **Article 325** prohibits discrimination on the grounds of **religion, race, caste, or sex** in the electoral process.
 
• It ensures that no person is ineligible for inclusion in the electoral rolls on these discriminatory grounds.
 
 
 
• **Article 327**__
 
 
• **Article 327** gives the Parliament the power to make laws with respect to all matters relating to **elections to the Legislature**.
 
• This includes the preparation of electoral rolls, the conduct of elections, and any other related matters.
